desc:
🍎 Welcome to Steal A Fruit!

How to Play:
🍎 Steal fruits from the Grumpy Farmer's orchard
🌱 Plant seeds and grow rare fruit trees
💰 Earn money from your fruits
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
✨ Discover rarer fruits, seeds, trees, sizes, and mutations!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
